from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Pt
from copy import deepcopy
from lxml import etree
import shutil, os

SRC = "${DEMO}/company-decks/brand/company-design-template.pptx"
OUT = "${DEMO}/company-decks/Sprint 1.pptx"

shutil.copyfile(SRC, OUT)
prs = Presentation(OUT)

layouts = {l.name: l for l in prs.slide_layouts}
print("Layouts:", list(layouts.keys()))

# Drop the four sample slides so we start from a clean template.
sldIdLst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
rels = prs.part.rels
for sldId in list(sldIdLst):
    rId = sldId.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
    sldIdLst.remove(sldId)
    prs.part.drop_rel(rId)

def set_ph(slide, idx, text):
    ph = slide.placeholders[idx]
    ph.text = text
    return ph

def set_body_bullets(slide, ph_idx, items):
    tf = slide.placeholders[ph_idx].text_frame
    tf.text = items[0]
    for extra in items[1:]:
        p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = extra

# ---- Slide 1: Title
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Title"])
# ctrTitle is placeholder idx 0, subTitle idx 1 (per layout XML).
s1.placeholders[0].text = "Sprint 1 review"
s1.placeholders[1].text = "Team Skycast · closed 2026-09-24"

# ---- Slide 2: Sprint at a glance
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
s2.placeholders[0].text = "Sprint at a glance"
set_body_bullets(s2, 1, [
    "Theme: the week view and the first round of fixes",
    "Milestone due 2026-09-23, closed 2026-09-24",
    "2 issues closed, 2 user-facing PRs merged (1 feature, 1 bug)",
    "Internal work excluded from this review",
])

# ---- Slide 3: Shipped
s3 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
s3.placeholders[0].text = "Shipped: 7-day forecast"
set_body_bullets(s3, 1, [
    "Issue #1 → PR #2",
    "Delivered: the next seven days, today first",
])

# ---- Slide 4: Fixed
s4 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
s4.placeholders[0].text = "Fixed: temperature unit by region"
